name: Harmonia
author: E. T. Carter
description: Modular times-table string art: points spaced evenly round a circle, each strung with a straight chord to the point at its multiple. The crowd of chords traces the envelope curves hidden in the times tables - the cardioid, the nephroid, the higher roses - and as the multiplier slowly breathes the whole figure morphs from one curve into the next. Every strand is dead straight; the glowing curves are only the shapes their tangents draw.

params.label: Points
params.effect: How many points sit round the circle; few gives a coarse star of chords, many a finely sampled envelope that reads as smooth glowing curves.

params.label: Multiplier
params.effect: The base times-table factor: 2 draws the cardioid, 3 the nephroid, higher values open into multi-lobed roses.

params.label: Morph
params.effect: How far the multiplier breathes around its base, slowly morphing the envelope between neighbouring figures; 0 holds one fixed curve (still slowly spinning).

params.label: Chord weight
params.effect: Half-width of each chord in CSS px; thin keeps the envelope crisp and wiry, thick blooms the strands into soft neon.

params.label: Chord tint
params.effect: Colour of the chords: 0 strings them plain white, 1 runs full palette hues round the figure so the envelope reads in colour.

params.label: Radius
params.effect: Size of the point circle as a fraction of the frame; small floats a compact figure, large pushes the chords near the edges.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around each chord; low keeps fine coloured lines, high lets the dense overlap glow as luminous body.
